evidence.quote: However, the Committee decided to await more evidence that progress will be sustained before adjusting the pace of its purchases.
the Committee decided to continue purchasing additional agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $40 billion per month and longer-term Treasury securities at a pace of $45 billion per month.
the tightening of financial conditions observed in recent months, if sustained, could slow the pace of improvement in the economy and labor market.
The Committee recognizes that inflation persistently below its 2 percent objective could pose risks to economic performance
a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy will remain appropriate for a considerable time after the asset purchase program ends and the economic recovery strengthens.

parsed.rationale: The Committee kept rates near zero and chose not to taper its asset purchases, citing tightening financial conditions, fiscal restraint, and below-target inflation. It also reaffirmed highly accommodative guidance, so the net signal is dovish despite noting diminished downside risks and some underlying strength.
